about_the_game:
In Codename: Twilight Shadow, you will be immersed in a cyber world full of mysteries, disguised as a top hacker to secretly infiltrate, break through the layers of anti-theft system security mechanisms, collect evidence and restore the truth. Here you can be an all-round ACE, from sneaking invasion, clue analysis, to hot-blooded parkour, stronghold management, independent planning and planning, full control of the infiltration mission. Here you can also work with your hacker partners, someone is the king of logic clue reasoning, someone is responsible for the technical assistance device crack easily, someone is a small information collection expert arachnid traces of all do not let go of, and your partners to form the strongest hacking team, work together to complete every thrilling infiltration mission.

The game uses a unique 3D visual style and non-linear plot system, a blend of puzzle solving, reasoning, parkour, management of a variety of gameplay, to bring a tense and exciting and highly immersive hacker adventure experience.

Dive into the spy shadow, hacker action

You will disguise as a highly skilled hacker and infiltrate the mysterious AWA R&D company. By hacking into terminals, intercepting communications, and cracking firewalls, you will gain access to the truth hidden behind experimental records and R&D materials. Behind every experimenter lies a secret, and the clues will piece together the complete truth, revealing the company's unknown conspiracy.

High-energy mystery solving, challenging the limits

AWA has set up a large number of security systems and electronic puzzles inside, from password access control to logical pathways, from clue combinations to physical device operations, each puzzle tests your reasoning and hands-on skills. The game has hundreds of puzzles with increasing complexity, waiting for you who like to solve puzzles with your brain to dig out the hidden secrets.

Utilize the terrain, sneak and run

Some areas are heavily guarded, and cracking alone is not enough. You need to observe the terrain, look for ventilation ducts, hidden passages or use props to disguise your identity, and even run and jump to get favorable treasures. The fusion of infiltration and parkour brings you an intense and exciting adventure experience.

Join hands to operate and decrypt

Here you can no longer fight alone! In this mission to infiltrate the AWA R&D company, you can form a hacker team with your partners and divide the work to crack multiple protection systems. You can also run a secret base together to complete the mission, get more hidden clues, and cooperate with each other to gradually uncover the truth.

short_description: The treacherous world of Cyber Neon and Data Mist, with the core gameplay of puzzle solving, deduction and parkour. Single-player or multi-player play as a time and space hacker, collect the subtle evidence scattered everywhere, to reveal the unknown shocking truth.
